name: omni-watermark-cleaner
description: Remove the visible Gemini/Omni sparkle watermark from generated videos while preserving the rest of the frame.

scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare:runtime:mac && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.macos.conf.json --bundles app,dmg
scripts.build:windows: npm run prepare:runtime:windows && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.windows.conf.json --bundles nsis,msi
scripts.check: node --check src/omni-watermark.js && node --check src/omni-image-watermark.js && node --check ui/app.js
